disposition_reason: Supports measured gallium in river sediment near mining and its low mobility. Does not address food or water intake.
disposition_locator: Results and Abstract; Results; Results; secondary

study.method: Sediments were digested with nitric acid, hydrogen peroxide and hydrofluoric acid and analyzed by ICP-MS; mobility was assessed by sequential chemical extraction.

regulatory_or_exposure: Sediment gallium average 11.8 mg/kg, maximum 25.6 mg/kg
